title: TimeKits — Coming Soon!
author: BYTE Play Devs
excerpt: A new server is on the horizon. RandomKits PvP with a timed twist — kill to survive, survive to play.

content.html: We're officially announcing our next project: TimeKits.
More details are coming closer to launch. For now, here's what we can share.
TimeKits is a RandomKits PvP server — you drop in with a random kit, no choice, no preparation.
The twist: you have a timer. Run out of time and you're out.
Every kill you land adds time back to the clock. Stop killing and the clock catches up with you.
It rewards aggression and punishes passive play in a way that standard kit PvP never does.
All updates will be posted here and announced in our Discord first.
Join the server to get notified the moment we go live.
